meta.name: product-demand-research
meta.description: Use when the user wants to validate a product idea, find pain points, mine demand signals, discover objections, or gather voice-of-customer language from Reddit, social posts, video transcripts, and comments. Produces evidence-backed product research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从真实讨论中挖掘产品需求与用户痛点，产出有据可查的研究结论。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在验证产品创意，想从用户讨论里找到真实痛点与需求。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're validating a product idea and want evidence-backed research from user conversations.

howto.what: 用这个技能时,Claude 会把你的产品想法变成搜索词,去 Reddit 等社交平台找相关评论和帖子,摘出用户原话、痛点、替代方案、反对意见,最后给出一份附来源、带需求强弱判断和结论的研究报告。
howto.when: 当你要求验证产品想法、找痛点或挖掘需求信号,或想从 Reddit、社交媒体帖子、视频字幕等收集用户原话时触发。

say.text: 在 TikTok 评论里找人们想要却没有的健身工具,列出用户原话和反对意见。
say.note: 会输出痛点表格和反对意见。

say.text: 从 YouTube 字幕里找‘远程协作’的痛点,整理成需求报告并列出替代方案。
say.note: 会按格式产出研究结论和产品建议。

howto.what_en: Claude turns your idea into queries, searches Reddit and social platforms for posts/comments, clusters pain points, alternatives, objections, then outputs a report with demand verdict, confidence, messaging angles, and product ideas.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to validate a product idea, find pain points, mine demand signals, or collect customer language from Reddit, social posts, video transcripts, or comments.

say_en.text: Validate idea: bookkeeping app for freelancers. Search Reddit for complaints.
say_en.note: Claude will search relevant posts and give a demand verdict.

say_en.text: Check TikTok comments for missing fitness tools; list quotes and objections.
say_en.note: Outputs a pain-point table and objections.

say_en.text: Find remote-collaboration pain points in YouTube subtitles; list alternatives.
say_en.note: Produces research conclusions and product suggestions.
